description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
Kodama of the East Tree, Auton Soldier, and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium onto the battlefield.
Auton Soldier and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Auton Soldier token's trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
